title: Unicorn holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 12 Q66 28 58 42 Q54 50 56 56' stroke='#88ddff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='14' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='14' rx='11' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#ff88aa' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='10' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ff99bb'/>
  <polygon points='62,27 59,31 65,31' fill='#cc2244'/>
  <!-- unicorn body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#ffe0f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='22' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ffe0f0' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='38' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ffd0e8' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='50' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ffe0f0' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='58' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ffd0e8' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='90' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#cc88aa'/>
  <rect x='38' y='90' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#cc88aa'/>
  <rect x='50' y='90' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#cc88aa'/>
  <rect x='58' y='90' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#cc88aa'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 64 Q10 56 14 46 Q18 40 12 36' stroke='#ff88cc' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 64 Q8 60 10 50' stroke='#ffaadd' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M55 58 Q64 46 60 38' stroke='#ffe0f0' stroke-width='12' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#ffe0f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='13' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='42' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#ffd0e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='42' rx='8' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#ffb0d0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#7733aa'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='42' r='1' fill='#cc88aa'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M52 30 Q49 20 55 24 Q57 26 56 31' fill='#ffe0f0' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- horn -->
  <polygon points='58,28 60,8 64,28' fill='#ffdd44' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='25' x2='60.5' y2='18' stroke='#ffaa00' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='27' x2='62' y2='20' stroke='#ffaa00' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M52 30 Q44 26 46 36 Q42 34 44 42 Q40 42 44 50' stroke='#ff66cc' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 34 Q48 32 50 40' stroke='#cc44aa' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front leg holding string -->
  <path d='M56 60 Q60 54 58 50' stroke='#ffe0f0' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='49' r='3.5' fill='#ffd0e8' stroke='#ffc0dd' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- string connect to hoof -->
  <path d='M58 46 Q57 50 58 49' stroke='#88ddff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='41' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#ff99cc' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
